title: Pipeline target picture: tests before delivery, delivery lanes, central source API
summary: Updates the target picture after Robert's request of 20 October 2026. Tests: per card only build, affected tests and fast checks; after merge, window checks and a nightly full suite on develop; the full suite once on the release candidate before delivery, optional per project; red develop is attributed and repaired by revert or fix forward, and holds releases, not merges. Delivery lanes: a Delivery section after Done & Decide with one column per declared environment, landed and waiting cards projected from releases, deploy runs and CardsSinceLastDeploy (AGT-3201), cards keep their lane state; no Dev environment exists today. Central API: the Task Server serves card state, board and artefacts, derived diffs, history and blame replace request-time git, host object caches replace gate bundles, the workspace repository becomes an export. Ten decisions D1 to D10 with recommendations and thirteen implementation cards.

# Attribution and repair cards for a red develop: revert or fix forward

Source of truth: `docs/pipeline-delivery-target/index.html` (AGT-3276). Use the Dossier's recommended option for each open decision unless a recorded operator decision selects another, and record which option you implemented. Section 03 "Failures after merge", decision D2. Transition rules belong in `orchestration-decisions/`; hosts only collect facts and apply decisions.

## Deliver

1. Attribution facts: suspects are the first-parent merges between the last green SHA and the red tip; narrow by intersecting changed paths with the failing tests' project map, then re-run only the failing tests at merge points, then bisect if more than one suspect remains. Run flaky quarantine (AGT-W57 D3) first.
2. A pure decision in `orchestration-decisions/` choosing `revert`, `fix-forward` or `escalate` from typed facts (unique suspect, revert applies cleanly, later merges depend on it, red age).
3. Repair card through the `FailureInterventionService` fingerprint pattern: one card per fingerprint, with attributed merge, failing tests and log excerpt. A revert runs under the publication lease and reopens the original card in Preparation with the failure attached.
4. Containment: a red develop holds release-candidate creation; cards whose changed paths overlap the failing area wait; others keep merging. After 2 hours red, escalate to the Human Operator and offer switching the project back to the pre-merge batch gate.

## Acceptance criteria

- Decision-table tests for every branch; `TransitionDecisionBoundaryTests` and `MonolithDecisionBoundaryTests` stay green.
- A repeated identical red run creates no second card; a green run closes the incident and records red time.

# Diff objects and derived history and blame for review

Source of truth: `docs/pipeline-delivery-target/index.html` (AGT-3276). Use the Dossier's recommended option for each open decision unless a recorded operator decision selects another, and record which option you implemented. Section 05 rows "Diff against merge base" and "History and blame", decision D7. Implements AGT-3017 D1 and the git-facts option C target.

## Deliver

1. Producer on the runner host computes, at result handoff and on demand: diff against merge base (name list and unified diff within the review budget of 200 files and 12,000 lines), path history and blame for touched files; publishes to the Task Server with producer epoch fencing.
2. Task Server stores diff objects and derived rows by immutable key; no TTL, size-bounded eviction.
3. Remote Review reads review material from the Task Server and falls back to a local `git diff` only when the object is missing, recording the miss.
4. Card-open provenance and file history read derived data; no request-time git.

## Acceptance criteria

- The same base and head yield byte-identical material from producer and fallback.
- Zero git spawns on card open in the Agent Studio board measurement; review material time p95 reported.
